sloka: पितुः शरीर निर्वाणम् निष्टनन् विषसाद ह ।स तु दृष्ट्वा रुदन् दीनः पपात धरणी तले ॥२-७७-९॥
transliteration: pituḥ śarīra nirvāṇam niṣṭanan viṣasāda ha ।sa tu dṛṣṭvā rudan dīnaḥ papāta dharaṇī tale ॥2-77-9॥

translations.english: On seeing the cremation ground desolate Bharata collapsed sobbing on the ground like a fastened flag staff of Indra, which fell as it was being raised.
